The epitope-specific mAb 4C3 bound to enzymatically deglycosylated Bla g 2 with about 40-fold lower affinity. MAb 4C3 was able to bind Bla g 2 with mutation N268Q, which prevented glycosylation at that residue. Mutations E233A or E233R partially reduced mAb 4C3 binding, while mutation K251A or double mutation E233R/I199W abolished binding.

The epitopic residues, identified by X-ray crystallography, were confirmed to be critical for mAb 4C3 binding because binding was reduced to Bla g 2 single alanine mutants K251A, E233A or mutants E233R-I199W or E233R-I199W-N268Q captured on solid phase by non-overlapping mAb 7C11. The mutant Bla g 2 proteins were also shown to have reduced capacity to inhibit 4C3 binding to solid phase Bla g 2.  Bla g 2, with mutation N93Q to prevent N-linked glycosylation, was used as the solid phase antigen. The N-linked carbohydrate added to residue N268 has been shown to be involved in IgE and mAb binding.

The epitope of 4C3 Fab on Bla g 2 was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The details of the structure were previously described in the reference cited: Li et al. (2011) J Immunol 186: 333-340 [PMID: 21123808]. The N-linked carbohydrate added to residue N268 is shown to be involved in mAb binding.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 1.8 angstroms

The epitope of 7C11 Fab' on Bla g 2 was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. In the crystals, a dimer of the antigen interacts with two Fab-prime molecules, forming two 1:1 complexes, related by a non-crystallographic 2-fold symmetry operation. Each antibody interacts with only one out of two monomers.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.81 angstroms

The mutant Bla g 2 proteins also were shown to have reduced capacity to inhibit 7C11 binding to solid phase Bla g 2.  Bla g 2, with mutation N93Q to prevent N-linked glycosylation, was used as the solid phase antigen.
